name: Gantt Chart
description:
Project tasks on a timeline that users reschedule by dragging, saved with your own PL/SQL.

Source: any region source with one row per task. Map ID, Name, Start and End; Progress, Dependencies, Color and Description are optional. Timeline: Hour, Quarter Day, Half Day, Day, Week, Month and Year views with view buttons, a Today button, today's line, weekend shading, dependency arrows, expected progress and a details popup. Editing: drag a bar to move it, drag its ends to change its length, drag the handle to change progress; tasks that depend on it move along. The Save Code gets :ID, :START_DATE, :END_DATE and :PROGRESS; if it fails the task goes back and its message is shown.

Live demo: sign in as demo with the password Demo.

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later. Documentation, updates and more plug-ins: https://www.techrevx.com
